request: Round 45, twenty-second build (incremental on the nineteenth): MoltBrowser creates WebRTC-Aec3TransparentModeHmm/Disabled before Chromium's field trial testing config, so the echo canceller uses its own default transparent mode (--force-fieldtrials still wins); and the grammar takes more command words as the recognizer hears them in the test voices ("open the book, Mark", "windjo", "fine", "scroll to the borrow", "take"/"tech" for type into a field...: the right command for 92% of the suite's phrases through the helper, from 88%). The twenty-first run, with the trial forced, gave 75% file, 84% noloop, 73% with the speakers.
